caption: 01 · SEE — Who is actually in the institution?. Begin with people and entities, not an idealized org chart. Record each role, the work performed, employment or contracting status if verified, jurisdiction, decision authority, dependencies, and the evidence supporting the entry. Unknown must remain unknown.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping who is actually in the institution? within The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · HAND OFF — What crosses between them?. A sketch, toile, pattern, specification, fitting note, approval, image, sample, purchase order, credential, or verbal correction carries different kinds of knowledge. Bind every consequential handoff to a named sender, receiver, version, decision, deadline, and return path.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what crosses between them? within The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · CREDIT — Whose labor becomes visible?. Public credit, legal authorship, ownership, compensation, and cultural recognition are different fields. Preserve the contributor’s preferred name and role while separately recording the governing contract or policy and any disputed or omitted attribution.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping whose labor becomes visible? within The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · TEST POWER — Who can stop, change, approve, or leave?. Map vetoes, approvals, revision burdens, payment triggers, confidentiality, reuse, termination, safety escalation, archive access, and correction. A glamorous credit list without decision and remedy fields can still hide the institution.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

caption: Making invisible labor visible can itself become extractive: a house may display names while withholding pay, authority, safety, ownership, or meaningful consent. Some contributors may also need privacy. Credit is therefore a negotiated record—not a substitute for lawful working conditions, fair compensation, or power.
alt: Counterpoint card for The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection.
